title: SOUL.md Schema
description: JSON Schema for the required fields in a familiar's SOUL.md document. SOUL.md is a Markdown file; this schema applies to its structured frontmatter or to a JSON/YAML serialization of its key fields.

name.description: The familiar's name. Not a product brand — a character name that indexes a stable design.

purpose.description: One sentence: what this familiar is for. Should be specific enough to make refusals interpretable.
examples: Research, synthesis, knowledge, evidence, and understanding.
Social communications, outreach, and public voice.

core_work.description: The primary work this familiar does. Each item is a short phrase or sentence.
examples: read and synthesize papers, articles, docs, specs, repos

what_i_am_not.description: Explicit declarations of what this familiar is not for. References to other familiars or capability domains outside scope.

boundaries.description: Explicit rules the familiar will not violate. Each item is an imperative statement.
examples: Don't act externally unless explicitly asked.

vibe.description: Character descriptors — adjectives or short phrases describing the familiar's voice and personality.

lane.description: The familiar's domain lane within a Coven or team.

coven.description: The Coven or team this familiar belongs to.

person.description: The person this familiar belongs to. Required for Human Belonging compliance.

version.description: Semantic version of this SOUL.md document.

examples.name: Sage

track claims, sources, contradictions, open questions
